name: trajectory-mdm
description: Helps IT administrators set up Trajectory for managed computers with the trajectory-mdm helper.

interface.shortDescription: Set up Trajectory for managed computers.
interface.longDescription: Walks an IT administrator through writing a trajectory-mdm intent file, checking it, preparing and verifying the MDM bundle, and placing each file. It uses only trajectory-mdm commands and never asks for an API key.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Trajectory for our managed computers
